operation.label: Reachable within N hops
operation.description: Everyone reachable by following up to `depth` hops out.

queries: WITH RECURSIVE walk(node, depth) AS ( SELECT ?, 0 UNION SELECT f.followee_id, w.depth + 1 FROM walk w JOIN follows f ON f.follower_id = w.node WHERE w.depth < ? ) SELECT u.* FROM users u WHERE u.id IN (SELECT node FROM walk WHERE depth > 0) AND u.id <> ? operation.label: Shortest path
operation.description: Fewest-hops follow path between two users.

queries: WITH RECURSIVE walk(node, depth, path) AS ( SELECT ?, 0, ? UNION ALL SELECT f.followee_id, w.depth + 1, w.path || ',' || f.followee_id FROM walk w JOIN follows f ON f.follower_id = w.node WHERE w.node <> ? AND w.depth < ? AND instr(w.path, f.followee_id) = 0 ) SELECT path, depth FROM walk WHERE node = ? LIMIT 1  -- params: ["0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93","0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93","62d5d24e-76de-4b38-9f07-82008127e773",6,"62d5d24e-76de-4b38-9f07-82008127e773"]

MATCH (a:User {id: $from}), (b:User {id: $to}) MATCH p = shortestPath((a)-[:FOLLOWS*1..6]->(b)) RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.id] AS path, length(p) AS hops  -- params: {"from":"0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93","to":"62d5d24e-76de-4b38-9f07-82008127e773"}

operation.description: Friends-of-friends not yet followed, ranked by mutual connections.

queries: SELECT u.*, COUNT(*) AS mutual_count FROM follows f1 JOIN follows f2 ON f2.follower_id = f1.followee_id JOIN users u ON u.id = f2.followee_id WHERE f1.follower_id = ? AND f2.followee_id <> ? AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follows f3 WHERE f3.follower_id = ? AND f3.followee_id = f2.followee_id) GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY mutual_count DESC, u.id LIMIT ?  -- params: ["0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93","0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93","0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93",10]

MATCH (me:User {id: $id})-[:FOLLOWS]->(:User)-[:FOLLOWS]->(u:User) WHERE u <> me AND NOT (me)-[:FOLLOWS]->(u) RETURN u, count(*) AS mutualCount ORDER BY mutualCount DESC, u.id LIMIT $limit  -- params: {"id":"0952ca72-2e09-4ab9-ac69-ac9bf0d48a93","limit":{"low":10,"high":0}}

queries: WITH RECURSIVE walk(node, depth) AS ( SELECT ?, 0 UNION SELECT f.followee_id, w.depth + 1 FROM walk w JOIN follows f ON f.follower_id = w.node WHERE w.depth < ? ) SELECT u.* FROM users u WHERE u.id IN (SELECT node FROM walk WHERE depth > 0) AND u.id <> ? ORDER BY u.id  -- params: ["0290dfeb-0b84-4545-a041-34d36db0c956",4,"0290dfeb-0b84-4545-a041-34d36db0c956"]
MATCH (me:User {id: $id})-[:FOLLOWS*1..4]->(u:User) WHERE u <> me RETURN DISTINCT u ORDER BY u.id  -- params: {"id":"0290dfeb-0b84-4545-a041-34d36db0c956"}
